description: Force one control in or out of scope (write — editor+). 'include'/'exclude' pin it; 'inherit' clears it. Excluding an MCR or material control needs an admin key and a reason (editors 403).

action.description: 'include' pins the control in scope, 'exclude' pins it out, 'inherit' clears the override AND discards the recorded rationale (it stays in the audit trail)

reason.description: Why this control is being overridden — recorded in the audit trail (max 2000 characters). Required for 'exclude'. The admin making an MCR or material exclusion is recorded as its approver; there is no approver parameter

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_set_scope_override
